description: This PHP file defines the class AuthParams within the namespace OrangeHRM\Authentication\Dto. The class implements AuthParamsInterface and encapsulates authentication parameters such as user credentials and an attribute bag, providing methods to retrieve clones of these properties.

classes.name: AuthParams
classes.description: Represents authentication parameters including user credentials and attribute bag, with methods to retrieve cloned instances of these properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an AuthParams instance with optional user credentials and attribute bag.

methods.name: getCredential
methods.description: Returns a clone of the stored UserCredentialInterface object representing user credentials.

methods.name: getAttributeBag
methods.description: Returns a clone of the stored AuthAttributeBagInterface object representing authentication attributes.
